entries.name: Create figure (matplotlib)
entries.description: Complete matplotlib block — imports, figure, axis labels, tight layout, show.
entries.template:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

{v:fig}, {v:ax} = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))
{v:ax}.plot({v:x_values}, {v:y_values}, marker="o", linewidth=1.5)
{v:ax}.set_xlabel("x")
{v:ax}.set_ylabel("y")
{v:ax}.set_title("TODO: title")
{v:fig}.tight_layout()
plt.show()
